scope: Selected firsthand customer reports, not a representative sample or clinical evidence. Capsules and gummies are kept separate. No aggregate review rating created.
access_limit: Amazon product page returned 503; Woot review text was retrieved through indexed search. Woot identifies the quotes as Amazon reviews.

selected_quotes.heading: A positive experience
selected_quotes.text: these definitely help with strong odors!
selected_quotes.author: Brianna Whittington
selected_quotes.context: Reviewer reports doing outdoor work and sweating, easy swallowing and no unwanted effects. Menopause status not stated.

selected_quotes.heading: A mixed experience
selected_quotes.text: Haven’t noticed much difference since stopping
selected_quotes.author: Vinerrr
selected_quotes.context: Six months use, felt fresher but questioned repurchase value; capsules large. Menopause status not stated.

additional_sources.finding: Reviewers describing menopause report perceived improvements in odor or comfort. Not an independent sample.
Burning and itching reported during URO use. Other conditions/treatments mentioned. No causal conclusion.
2 capsules, 60 per bottle; 5B CFU in four Lactobacillus species blend, 400 mg XOS.
2 gummies, 60 per bottle; B. coagulans SNZ 1969, 1B CFU; vitamin C 45mg, D3 50mcg, added sugar.
